name: seo-skills
description: Installable Agent Skills library for evidence-led SEO audits and recommendations.
author: Bourd Pty Ltd

scripts.validate:skills-ref: for skill in skills/*; do npx --yes skills-ref validate "$skill" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run sync:skills && bun run validate:skills && bun run smoke:install
scripts.check:public: bun run check && bun run validate:skills-ref && bun run smoke:cli
